message.content:
Based on the three screenshots provided, here is the evaluation for each:

### **Image 1: Home Page – Projects Section**
*   **(a) Are the project images clearly visible?**  
    **Yes.** The three project cards display high-quality, real installation photos (solar panels and battery storage). The images are sharp, well-lit, and fill the card areas effectively.
*   **(b) Is text readable?**  
    **Yes.** The text uses a high-contrast white font against a dark gradient overlay on the images. The Arabic typography is clear, legible, and well-spaced.
*   **(c) Professional?**  
    **Yes.** The layout features modern rounded corners, consistent iconography (lightning bolts for kilowatts), and a clean grid system that looks polished and trustworthy.

### **Image 2: Projects Listing Page**
*   **(a) Are the project images clearly visible?**  
    **Yes.** The hero banner image at the top shows workers installing panels with excellent clarity. The partial project card visible at the bottom right also shows a clear installation photo.
*   **(b) Is text readable?**  
    **Yes.** The large white heading "مشاريعنا" (Our Projects) stands out sharply against the darker background of the hero image. The statistics cards below use dark green text on white backgrounds, ensuring perfect readability.
*   **(c) Professional?**  
    **Yes.** The design employs a sophisticated "stats bar" with icons (calendar, chart, lightning, briefcase) that conveys credibility and data-driven results. The breadcrumb navigation adds to the professional structure.

### **Image 3: Project Detail Page**
*   **(a) Are the project images clearly visible?**  
    **Yes.** The full-width hero image showing the solar panel mounting structure is crisp, detailed, and serves as an impressive visual anchor for the page.
*   **(b) Is text readable?**  
    **Yes.** Similar to the other pages, the main title and capacity number ("409.2 كيلووات") are rendered in large, bold white text over a darkened image overlay, making them highly legible. The body text below on the white background is also very clear.
*   **(c) Professional?**  
    **Yes.** This page demonstrates a high level of detail with a structured "Project Specifications" (مواصفات المشروع) sidebar containing key data points (Capacity, System Type, Location, Year). This organized presentation of technical information is characteristic of a professional B2B or engineering portfolio site.
